Stamford is a great place to live as it is centrally located and only moments away from many dining experiences, renowned education, loads of shopping and exploration await as major highways/international airports easily whisk you way to either a fun-filled day or a destination vacation. NYC, Hartford nearby with Providence & Boston a short distance away. Stamford is excited to welcome you & your tenant's home!
